name: HTTP/S Request
description: An HTTP/S request — also called web traffic, an HTTP(S) request/response, a browser-to-server call, or web-layer traffic — client-to-server web traffic crossing the perimeter carrying requests and responses. The primary inbound web channel. The place to look for HTTP/HTTPS traffic, web requests/responses, browser-to-server calls, or the web-layer flow entering the system.
